strict_group.GSE214546: young adults <=40 (16 donors) versus old >60 (7 donors); pediatric excluded

atlas_group.rule: same young donors; old >=60, adding F60/M60 in Zhu and PB00015/PB00566 in Thomson

exact_age.GSE213516: all 17 exact-age healthy donors, continuous years
exact_age.GSE214546: all 32 exact-age adult confirmatory scRNA donors (16 young adults and 16 older adults), continuous years; pediatric excluded

eligibility.model: Full rank with residual degrees of freedom >1. P1/pseudobulk use only donors passing the 20-cell floor. CLR fits all design donors once a cell type passes the floor, retaining zeros with the declared pseudocount.
eligibility.hellinger: Actual raw UMI >=1500, >=20 passing cells per donor, >=2 strict-young reference donors, >=50 cross-fitted reference cells and positive reference counts, >=6 scored donors, full-rank model.
eligibility.P1: At least one uniquely mapped detected P1 up and one down gene per cohort/cell type.
eligibility.ineligible: Write an explicit row with the failed floor; never report it as a null effect.

covariates.primary: old indicator plus male indicator where identifiable; exact-age sensitivity replaces the old indicator with numeric years.
covariates.depth_sensitivity: P1/Hellinger add donor mean natural-log actual raw UMI per cell; pseudobulk adds donor mean log raw UMI despite CPM normalization; CLR adds log(total released annotated cells).
covariates.thomson_identifiability: Before fitting, tabulate sex, CMV, B-batch and P-pool levels by age group, rank, residual degrees of freedom and depth association. Primary remains age/group+sex. Add CMV, B-batch, or P-pool separately only in labeled sensitivities when full rank. No unidentifiable covariate is retained.
covariates.hellinger_primary: Age/group+sex+depth; unadjusted and other covariate models are sensitivities.

P1_transport.normalization: Per-cell log1p(CPM) using actual raw full-feature library size; arithmetic donor mean within released cell label; score=mean up minus mean down. Gene symbols mapping to multiple feature IDs are excluded from P1/targeted claims rather than made unique artificially.
P1_transport.matched_null: Strict primary only: 200 draws, seed 20261114. Mean-donor logCPM expression deciles per cell type, up/down matched separately, all detected P1 genes excluded from the pool, sampling without replacement, one RNG stream across sorted cell types. Centered two-sided empirical p=(1+exceedances)/(200+1).
P1_transport.models: strict primary, strict depth, atlas primary, exact-age primary; Thomson CMV/batch/pool/depth sensitivities where eligible

donor_pseudobulk.aggregation: Sum raw counts within donor and released cell label. log2CPM=log2((gene_count+0.5)/(cell_type_total_count+1)*1e6). Old-minus-young or per-year OLS effect with model 95% CI.
donor_pseudobulk.targeted: CD8-naive PTGER2, CLIC1, S100A4, PRF1, GZMA, CCL5, expected increase. Six tests per cohort/design/model family. Require a defensible released CD8-naive label; otherwise untestable.
donor_pseudobulk.exploratory: All features detected in >=20% of eligible donors in each eligible released cell type. Separate models for each cohort/design; no feature filtering by effect or p-value. Full effect/CI/q table is gzip-compressed CSV.
donor_pseudobulk.genome_rule: Zhu feature IDs/symbols and reference records must be inspected before gene models. If hg19 versus GRCh38 remains unresolved, all Zhu gene claims are explicitly symbol-level only; no coordinate/locus/assembly claim and no ambiguous symbol mapping.

CLR_composition.transform: Add 0.5 cell to every released non-unknown label for each design donor, normalize within donor, then centered log-ratio.
CLR_composition.targeted: CD8-naive T-cell decrease, MAIT decrease, non-classical-monocyte increase. Three tests per cohort/design/model family; absent/non-harmonizable labels are untestable.
CLR_composition.exploratory: Every eligible released label; raw-fraction effects are descriptive sensitivity only.

Hellinger.reference: Strict-young donors only, independently within cohort and cell type. Subtract the scored donor's own counts for reference donors. Atlas/exact-age sensitivities retain this strict-young reference.
Hellinger.endpoint: Arithmetic donor mean per-cell Hellinger distance to the cross-fitted reference, no UMI downsampling.
Hellinger.models: Strict depth-adjusted primary; atlas/exact-age depth-adjusted sensitivities; strict unadjusted and Thomson covariate sensitivities

multiplicity_families.targeted_pseudobulk: BH at 0.05 over six targeted genes separately by cohort, design and model variant.
multiplicity_families.targeted_composition: BH at 0.05 over three targeted cell effects separately by cohort, design and model variant; only eligible tests enter BH and absent targets remain explicit untestable rows.
multiplicity_families.exploratory_pseudobulk: BH at 0.05 over all tested genes separately by cohort, design, model variant and cell type.
multiplicity_families.P1_CLR_Hellinger: BH at 0.05 over eligible cell types separately by cohort, endpoint, design and model variant. Strict P1 matched-null empirical p-values form a separate BH family.
multiplicity_families.replication: No BH family crosses cohorts. Replication is direction/effect-size/CI concordance, not pooled significance or equivalence from non-significance.

harmonization.rule: Use released labels only. Write the complete label inventory and an explicit source-label-to-common-label map before modeling. No integrated atlas labels or label transfer. Broad labels are not split to manufacture CD8-naive/MAIT/non-classical-monocyte targets.
harmonization.reporting: Forest plots use common labels with compatible estimands. Cohort-specific labels remain in aggregate CSVs; unmatched replication rows say untestable.

resources.guard: scripts/resource_guard.py for every expression download and analysis/validation/summarization job
resources.method: Per-donor downloads and per-donor processing; donor aggregate checkpoints only. No RAW tar or cross-cohort cell matrix.
